author: WS23 triangulation agent
inputs_frozen_at: post-WS22 registry and scorer (significance columns present, oracle specs marked)
FAMILY_A_definition: equal-weighted mean of driver-lines|margin_v2|b_elastic_rw, cycle-flex|flex_margin|l0_rw, margin-ts|sarima_margin|lines_aicc (WS22 group A amendment: the pre-named M1 spec, not the grid-picked b_elastic_eq; M4 ridge_all dropped at 37 parameters)

excluded_a_priori.alt-augmented|* (M4): WS22 group A weight 0; 15-37 parameters, worse than none on the margin
excluded_a_priori.street-bias|street_plus_bias|*: WS22 group C weight 0; fails W2 in dollars

weight_rule: At target quarter t, vintage v: prior = matched quarters q < t in the same window and horizon for which every member has a PIT point. raw_i = 1 / MAE_prior_i (equal-weighted over the prior quarters). w_inv = raw / sum(raw). w = (1 - lambda) * w_inv + lambda * (1/K). lambda = 0.5, fixed a priori, never tuned. Fewer than MIN_PRIOR=4 prior quarters -> equal weights. No weight is ever fitted on the quarter being forecast or on any later quarter.
full_sample_replay: identical machinery but MAE computed on every matched quarter in the window (including the target quarter and later ones). This is the hindsight measure, not a forecast.
guide_clip: If a QUARTERLY adj-EBITDA-margin guide is in force at vintage v for quarter t (guides_margin.csv, is_fy = False, guide_date <= v, target_period = t, latest wins): level = y[t-4] + value for metric adj_ebitda_margin_yoy_pts, or value for metric adj_ebitda_margin_pct. guide_type 'ceiling' -> point = min(point, level); 'floor' -> point = max(point, level); 'point' -> unchanged. Zero estimated parameters; the sentence is inside the h=0 information set (WS21 R17).
n_params_note: 1 shrinkage constant lambda (fixed a priori) + 1 fitted residual scale for the conformal band. The MEMBERS carry their own parameters: M5-disp 5, M5-flow 6, street 1, M3 1, M2-sent 2, FAMILY_A 10+12+15=37 -> 52 inherited. Stated in the note; the combination adds 2.
interval_rule: Split conformal on the combination's own PIT absolute errors at quarters that printed strictly before the vintage (so the band is point-in-time too). k = ceil((n+1)*(1-alpha)); qhat = k-th smallest |error|; if k > n, fall back to max|error| * (n+1)/n; if n < 4, fall back to 3.0 pp additive (margin) / 10% relative (dollars) and label it. Registry quantiles from WS20's methods are NOT used (cov80 0.91-1.00 against a nominal 0.80).

pass_line.primary: final-margin|combined|stack_clip beats the seasonal_naive baseline on adj_ebitda_margin_pct MAE at h=0 AND h=1, in BOTH windows (W1, W2) and BOTH weightings (equal, recency).
pass_line.secondary: stack_clip is not worse than the best single non-oracle object at the same target/horizon/window by more than 10% in either window. If it is, quote the best single object and say the combination does not help.
pass_line.reporting: Every ratio is reported with the NW(1) p-value, the quarters-better count and the exact sign test against seasonal_naive and against street (WS21 kill-list item 2). 'Survives both windows' is never quoted on its own.
pass_line.failure_policy: A failed test is written up in the note with its numbers, not deleted.

revenue_leg.live: bridge v3 / WS06 v2b, data/processed/margin_build/06_fy27_path_v2/06_revenue_path_3q26_4q27_v2b.csv and 06_annual_fy26_fy28_v2b.csv, base/bear/bull. LIVE-only, endorsed by WS22 group C.
